defensives.name: Blur
defensives.usage_rule: Pre-empt a telegraphed hit with the 25% damage reduction; it costs no rotational global, so never sit on it through avoidable damage.

defensives.name: Darkness
defensives.usage_rule: Drop it under the group for a stack-and-soak mechanic, giving everyone inside 8 yards a 15% chance to avoid each attack for 8 seconds.
